metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a ghost and somehow landed a solo uninstall? Valorant logic is wild
metadata.description:
Tapping like my mouse had a mind of its own
Enemy probably uninstalling from pure confusion
Did NOT deserve that unlucky lucky kill but hey, free chaos!

Tap if your aim’s mostly accidental chaos too!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
